config.blue: decider via AgentController (batched per tick), red: scripted basic_cycle
config.sim_matches_per_hour: 3600 / mean wall seconds per match, matches played one at a time; the decider drives one alliance (3 robots), the other alliance is scripted
config.exclusionRule: a match where more than half the decider robot decisions were fallbacks is excluded (listed in excludedMatches)
config.drexRealtimeOneAtATime: Drex realtime matches were played one at a time so the shared Drex limiter queue is not charged to the sim clock; Drex paused ran in a second process at the same time (at most 2 Drex matches in flight)
config.sharedLimiterLoad: from about 1:55 PM the integrator ran check-mode Drex matches from another worktree on the same shared Drex limiter, so Drex latencies (and realtime charges) after that time were measured under that extra load
config.answerKeyRunning: the answer key (11 rollout workers) ran on the same machine during these matches; wall times include that load
